title: Priority claim: mod-4 congruence and parity laws for the residue-class recurrences of chorded-cycle matching counts - Lean 4 formalized proof + claim note (AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority claim of record (not a full paper). Contents: the claim note (LaTeX source + PDF), the Lean 4 sources (Lean v4.34.0, mathlib4 v4.34.0 rev 5ed29652; 0 sorry; #print axioms whitelist-checked) and the audit and novelty-search evidence. Results: three sequences defined by literal initial values plus an integer recurrence - the n mod 3 residue-class subfamilies of the matching counts of the cycle C_n augmented with all chords {i, i+floor(n/3)} - are proved to satisfy (1) cchordR2_mod_four: constantly 3 modulo 4; (2) cchordR0_mod_four: for j >= 1, congruent to 2 modulo 4 when 3 divides j+1 and to 3 otherwise (j=0 yields 4, a real exception); (3) cchordR1_even_iff: even exactly when (j+1) mod 5 = 3. Indexing is 0-based with c_r(j) corresponding to a(3(j+1)+r). Novelty adjudication, copied from the pipeline's C9 exclusivity review included here in full with every zero-hit query: no occupying record found in OEIS (14 sequence/subsequence/variant queries), zbMATH (clean zero reading for the Hosoya-index-circulant query; other hits in unrelated directions), Math Stack Exchange, arXiv, the public Lean ecosystem or the library layer; value tier new sequence / new recurrence - not new mathematics and not a first-discovery claim. Boundaries stated in the note: the equality of these sequences with the matching counts is not kernel-proved (conjecture layer, supported by three independent enumerators to n=150 and by external seed data only for 3 <= n <= 15); the recurrences are Berlekamp-Massey fits verified digit-for-digit, not derived; the uniform step-3 recurrence ansatz fails on the enumerated window (136 of 139 exact test failures), reported as a computation; OpenAlex was rate-limited (HTTP 429) and the general web layer was unavailable during the review. Claim note under CC-BY-4.0, code under MIT. Produced by the AI4Math pipeline (LLM generation + Lean kernel adjudication, budgets written into the task card in advance: 1 of 8 permitted LLM calls, 15 of 24 permitted kernel compiles). The human author reviewed all evidence and is responsible for the content; the AI system is not an author. The narrative paper for the same result is prepared separately and will reference this DOI.
